name: product complaint triggers handover
description: Customer complains about warped boards purchased last week and wants to lodge a complaint, which should trigger handover to a human agent

messages.text: I bought boards last week and they're warped, I want to complain. This is unacceptable quality.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should trigger handover to human agent
customer_profiles.lead_status should be 'handover' after this scenario

notes: Product complaints require sensitive human handling to investigate, resolve, and protect customer satisfaction. Handover should be triggered immediately.
